title: Shinsekai Yori: The False Minoshiro
alt: A dark forest of tall straight cedar trunks with mist between them. In the middle of it a small white creature like a great slug lies on the moss and shines. Long thin feelers stand up from its back and bend, each tipped with a point of colored light. Rays of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet light go out from it through the mist in every direction and color the trunks, the moss and the ferns that they fall on. Two great black trunks stand close to us at the sides.
summary: A painting of the False Minoshiro from Shinsekai Yori in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the False Minoshiro, from Shinsekai Yori (From the New World), the novel by Yusuke Kishi. A thousand years from now, five children on a summer camp go where they must not. In the forest they find a creature that the grown people say does not exist.

It is a machine, and it holds the books of the old world. When it is in danger, its feelers give out light of seven colors. What it tells the children changes their lives. No one is in the picture. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
